CustomField.description: SUPERSEDED by Accrued_To_Date__c (LEAVE-51). Kept only so nothing that still points at it breaks; no Apex reads it any more, and it does NOT carry the LEAVE-52 rule, so for a continuing employee it reads a day lower than the real figure for most of the month. Delete once reports and list views have been moved over.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(Employee__r.Start_Date__c), Leave_Year__c > YEAR(TODAY()) ), 0, IF( Leave_Year__c < YEAR(TODAY()), BLANKVALUE(Entitlement_Days__c, 0), IF( Accrual_Method__c = "Monthly", MAX(0, MIN( BLANKVALUE(Entitlement_Days__c, 0), IF( YEAR(Employee__r.Start_Date__c) = Leave_Year__c, MONTH(TODAY()) - MONTH(Employee__r.Start_Date__c), MONTH(TODAY()) - 1 ) + IF( DAY(TODAY() + 1) = 1, 1, 0) )), BLANKVALUE(Entitlement_Days__c, 0) )))
CustomField.label: Accrued to Date (legacy formula)
